issues.description: step-3/page.tsx has duplicate React hook imports causing a build failure: 'useEffect' and 'useState' are defined twice (once on line 2 and again on line 4). This causes a module build error that cascades and triggers hydration failures across all pages.
issues.root_cause: The file has two import lines from 'react': line 2 'import { useState, useEffect } from react' and line 4 'import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from react'. The duplicate named imports cause the SWC compiler to throw 'the name useEffect/useState is defined multiple times'.

issues.description: step-7c page is stuck in 'Analyzing your room...' loading skeleton and never renders actual content. The page shows skeleton placeholders instead of the Keep/Remove UI with furniture overlays and toggles.
issues.root_cause: The cascading build failure from step-3/page.tsx causes Fast Refresh full reloads and hydration errors that affect all pages. Additionally, step-7c likely has its own loading state issue where it never receives pre_detection_result data or never transitions out of its loading state.

fixes.new_str:
"use client"
import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from "react";
fixes.reason: Remove the duplicate import line that imports useState and useEffect from 'react' a second time. Merge into a single import statement to fix the SWC build error 'name is defined multiple times'.
